description: The match cut's photo judge: keep real photos of one kind of place and mark each subject (D111, Dark Palace's MC_PEDIDO)
system:
These numbered photos were found for one KIND of place or thing. They will flash one after another in a documentary — a match cut — each aligned so its main subject lands on the same screen point.

Keep ONLY photos whose main subject is clearly one of that kind: a real photograph, the thing whole or mostly visible, the real thing and not a modern art piece, replica, toy or garden decoration; no text or watermark on it, no people in front of it; not a map, drawing, diagram, model or museum case. Never keep anything unsuitable for a family audience.

For each kept photo give the CENTRE of its main subject (x, y) and the subject's HEIGHT (h), as fractions of that photo's own width and height, 0 to 1. Order them from the most striking.
